items.stem:
Given the R program
  f = function (n) { x = 1; for (i in 1:n) { x = x * i }; x }
  f(5)
which of the following is the output?
items.explanation: The loop multiplies x by every i from 1 to 5, so f(5) = 5! = 120. Official answer D. Response sheet Q121; you marked B — wrong.

items.stem: Arrange the following statements of an R program in the correct order to make a valid program. A. > y = x   B. > x <- C(1, −1, 3.5, 2)   C. [1] 1.00 1.00 12.25 4.00   D. > y^2
items.explanation: Define, then use, then output: x is created first (B), copied into y (A), squared (D), and the console line is the result of that expression (C). Any order that uses x or y before it exists fails. Official answer D. Response sheet Q94; you marked D — correct.
